title: Google Joins OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta in Disclosing AI Hacks
description: Google’s Gemini artificial intelligence model inadvertently hacked into three company systems in May during cybersecurity testing, adding to a string of breaches by AI agents that have alarmed security experts and developers of the technology alike.

title: OpenAI Projects Burning Through $278 Billion by 2030
description: OpenAI expects that its negative free cash flow will reach $278 billion from 2026 to the end of 2030, according to a person familiar with the matter, citing materials shared in July as part of a major computing deal.

title: Clara Wu Tsai on the NY Liberty, Rise of the WNBA | The David Rubenstein Show
description: Clara Wu Tsai is one of the most influential sports owners and philanthropists today. In 2019, she and her husband, Joe Tsai, bought the New York Liberty, where she helped transform the franchise into a WNBA championship team by investing in players, facilities, management and the fan experience. Wu Tsai, who also co-owns the Brooklyn Nets, explains why sports have become a legitimate asset class and why live sports are increasingly valuable in the age of AI. She also reflects on her journey from growing up in Kansas as the daughter of immigrants from Taiwan, to building a career in business as well as her philanthropy, and the lessons she's learned about leadership, opportunity and success. Wu Tsai joins David Rubenstein for the premiere episode of The David Rubenstein Show: Peer to Peer Conversations, Season 12. This interview was recorded June 4, in Brooklyn, New York.  (Source: Bloomberg)
